selection_rule: First accepted repetition in each condition for development; second and third for evaluation. Condition/repetition mapping follows the conversation handoff and must be checked against bench metadata on the data host.
prior_exposure: Aggregate scores, onset times and before/after statistics for all recordings have already been inspected. This is an internal evaluation split fixed before implementing the new local-background method, not a previously unseen test dataset.

policy.stationary_records_role: Apply frozen new method for transfer verification; these records were already used in earlier baseline development, so they are not independent unseen data.
policy.remote_access: User runs commands; no agent SSH.
